data.title: Binance Completes Cartesi Lottery Draw and Will Open Trading For CTSI
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed the Cartesi lottery draw, with the results summarized below:

  • 22,169 total participants claimed a total of 155,585 tickets during the ticket claim period.
  • 7,356 participants had at least one winning ticket (33.18% user win rate).
  • 7,500 tickets won out of the155,585 tickets claimed (4.82% ticket win rate).

Binance will also open trading for CTSI/BNB, CTSI/BTC, CTSI/USDT and CTSI/BUSD trading pairs at 2020/04/23 2:00 AM (UTC).

CTSI Listing Fee: 0 BNB.

Note:

  • Please ensure that you have sufficient BNB in your account based on the number of your winning tickets. Users will have 24 hours until 2020/04/23 8:00 AM (UTC) to credit their exchange accounts with BNB, at which point the distribution of CTSI will be complete. Please note that BNB in open orders, margin accounts, lending products, sub-accounts, futures accounts, or fiat accounts will not be eligible to be deducted.
  • The token purchase price was set at CTSI = 0.00097911 BNB / 0.015 USD (using a BNB price of 15.32 USD), as per the previous announcement here.
  • The Cartesi (CTSI) ERC20 smart contract is available here.

  • Binance Launchpad: Cartesi Sale Results (Blog)

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team
